title: Personal generation rules
description: profiles/<slug>/rules.json — hand-written by the person, read (never written) by the generation skill. Every section is optional: anything absent falls back to default_rules in skills/generation/scripts/generate.config.json, and present sections override the default key-by-key.

exclude.description: Filtered out before any exercise is picked. Unknown names are reported as warnings, never silently skipped.

equipment.description: Dataset equipment values to avoid even when the gym tier allows them.

movement_groups.description: Dataset movement-group values to avoid entirely.

muscles.description: Muscle groups to drop from the plan entirely (injury, personal choice).
Groups this program biases toward when picking exercises.

must_include.description: Exact dataset exercise names guaranteed a slot when equipment and gates allow.

order.description: Session ordering rules, applied top-down: the first rule is the primary sort key, each later rule breaks remaining ties.
